Subject: Severance proposal and recommended offboard timing for EID 1234

Hi Markus and Karthik,

Following our call this morning, attached is the draft severance offer for employee EID 1234 (severance_offer_E1234_v1.pdf) and a proposed IT offboard checklist (offboard_it_checklist.xlsx). Key points: 

- Proposed package: 8 weeks base pay + 1 month continuation of health benefits, conditioned on a standard release agreement.
- Target effective separation date: 2026-07-15. We recommend notifying the employee the morning of 7/15; payroll cutoff / final paycheck to be processed on 7/16.
- Access revocation: we recommend immediate suspension of remote access at the time of notification, with credentials disabled within 2 hours. Onsite badge collection to be coordinated if necessary.
- Equity: accelerate the typical vesting conversation to HR; this will be handled separately with Total Rewards.

Please review the offer and confirm: (A) approve numbers, (B) confirm timing, (C) any contractual/region flags. I need a firm decision by COB Monday 7/13 to allow legal review and DocuSign setup.

If approved, I'll send to legal for a quick review and loop in IT for access plan.

Thanks,

Monica Patel

Monica — thanks for the ring-up and the draft. I reviewed the release and have two suggested edits: 

1) Add an explicit mutual-non-disparagement clause tied to the release. This reduces future reputational risk.
2) Clarify the governing law clause to reference the employee's primary work location (CA) and add an alternate venue for any disputes to avoid uncertainty.

Regarding the contractor history you mentioned: include a short factual recital confirming no pending contractor-engagement claims and add a representation from the employee that they have returned any third-party-owned code. It is best practice and reduces exposure.

I can send a redlined PDF by EOD today. Once you sign off on the language, we can prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Rebecca Low

All — thanks for the quick turn. Rebecca, appreciated — I incorporated your recommended nondisparagement and governing-law language; see redline attached. We will proceed with the following consolidated plan: 

1) Legal sign-off: Rebecca to send redlined PDF and DocuSign envelope by EOD 7/14.
2) Notification: target morning 2026-07-16, contingent on signed release. If the employee refuses to sign, HR and legal will advise on next steps (possible separation without release; we will document decision).
3) IT: Dev, stand by to suspend remote credentials immediately upon verbal confirmation from Karthik. Physical badge collection is optional; we'll request the employee return assets within 5 business days and lock remote access until receipt.
4) Payroll: final paycheck to be processed on 2026-07-16; benefits continuation to run for 30 days post-separation.
5) Communication: Markus, please send the customer-facing handover note to me by 9 AM 7/16 and I will coordinate internal comms.

Related links: https://redwood.app/hr/cases/E-1234 and DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123

If there are any objections, flag now. Otherwise Monica will send the DocuSign and monitor signature progress.
